correctness.rationale: The conditional real-spherical fourth-moment integral yields the exact cap coefficient b_d with a verified elementary primitive. The tight-frame sum removes other anisotropy; the rank-d simplex projector Gram and the addition-theorem trace give the complete spectrum. Comparing thresholds proves unique interior isotropy at d=3, and the Funk–Hecke degree-three integral proves the nonzero cubic moment. Complexification is justified by Hermitian polarization. A standalone direct-quadrature and algebra checker replayed from the final public package and passed 260 tests; it is not substituted for the proof.
